title: DesignAsCode: Bridging Structural Editability and Visual Fidelity in Graphic Design Generation
abstract: arXiv:2602.17690v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Graphic design generation demands a delicate balance between high visual fidelity and fine-grained structural editability. However, existing approaches typically bifurcate into either non-editable raster image synthesis or abstract layout generation devoid of visual content. Recent combinations of these two approaches attempt to bridge this gap but often suffer from rigid composition schemas and unresolvable visual dissonances (e.g., text-background conflicts) due to their inexpressive representation and open-loop nature. To address these challenges, we propose DesignAsCode, a novel framework that reimagines graphic design as a programmatic synthesis task using HTML/CSS. Specifically, we introduce a Plan-Implement-Reflect pipeline, incorporating a Semantic Planner to construct dynamic, variable-depth element hierarchies and a Visual-Aware Reflection mechanism that optimizes the code to rectify rendering artifacts. translated_title: DesignAsCode：在平面设计生成中架起结构可编辑性与视觉保真度之间的桥梁
translated_abstract: 平面设计生成需要在高视觉保真度与细粒度结构可编辑性之间取得微妙的平衡。然而，现有方法通常分化为两种路线：不可编辑的光栅图像合成，或缺乏视觉内容的抽象布局生成。近来将这两种方法相结合的尝试试图弥合这一差距，但由于其表达能力有限的表示形式和开环特性，往往受到僵化的组合模式以及无法解决的视觉不协调问题（例如文字与背景冲突）的困扰。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DesignAsCode，这是一个新颖的框架，它将平面设计重新构想为使用HTML/CSS的程序化合成任务。具体而言，我们引入了“规划-实现-反思”流水线，其中包含一个用于构建动态、可变深度元素层次结构的语义规划器，以及一个通过优化代码来纠正渲染缺陷的视觉感知反思机制。大量的实验……
tldr: DesignAsCode提出将平面设计生成重新构想为基于HTML/CSS的程序化合成任务，通过包含语义规划器和视觉感知反思机制的“规划-实现-反思”流水线，同时实现高视觉保真度与细粒度的结构可编辑性。
en_tdlr: DesignAsCode reimagines graphic design generation as a programmatic HTML/CSS synthesis task, employing a Plan-Implement-Reflect pipeline with a Semantic Planner and a Visual-Aware Reflection mechanism to achieve both high visual fidelity and fine-grained structural editability.
